CHILD No. 5 ENTERS WEISS FAMILY

A daughter was born recently to Mr. and Mrs. R. P. Weiss, of Ridgewood, Parma Township. This is the fifth youngster to enter the Weiss family and has been named Dorothy Virginia.

REBEKAH CARD PARTY

The Glendalia Rebecca Lodge will hold a card party in Glenn Hall, this (Friday) afternoon, Feb. 1, at 2 o'clock. Committee in charge: Mrs. M. F. Cutting, Mrs. C. F. Rombach, Mrs. S. Warner, Mrs. Hoffman and Mrs. Hummel.

LEGAL ADVERTISING — RESOLUTION
Declaring it Necessary to Construct and Maintain County Sewer District (1) Water Supply Improvement (49). WATER MAINS IN BIDDULPH ROAD.
BE IT RESOLVED By the Board of County Commissioners of Cuyahoga County, Ohio: Section 1. That for the preservation and protection of public health and welfare, and providing fire protection, it is necessary to construct and maintain a part, as hereinafter described, of a system of water supply and water works for Cuyahoga County, Sewer District 1, the general plans for which were approved on May 7, 1921. Section 2. ... Water Supply Improvement 49 ... Water mains in Biddulph road from West 77th Street to a point approximately 2800 feet west of West 77th Street; together with all necessary appurtenances. Section 4. That the estimated cost of the maintenance of such Improvement for one year is $1,000.00. ... A. F. Hirmer, Clerk.
